text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I heard Oguri's going to run in the Yasuda Kinen! The mile's one of my best distances, so I'm super excited to face her there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno's going to run in the Yasuda Kinen too! I'm beyond ecstatic to have my dream race right around the corner, but…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Later, when I run into Yaeno, she warned me that Oguri might devour my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer says Yaeno might not be feeling very confident because Oguri is so good in so many distances.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If Yaeno's feeling scared, then I have to show up and run so well, it'll prove to her that Oguri doesn't devour dreams!
